facts: Elizabeth Holmes is the founder and CEO of Theranos.
She served as a Presidential Ambassador for Global Entrepreneurship (PAGE).
Her Signature Initiative focuses on empowering women in science, technology, mathematics, and business.
Theranos worked on early detection, prevention, and consumer empowerment in healthcare.
The video file for the PAGE Video Series featuring Elizabeth Holmes is 81.06 MB in size.
The site contains archived information from December 2014 to January 2017.
